product_one_liner.value: Authentic8’s Silo provides secure, anonymous digital-investigation workspaces for intelligence analysts, security teams, financial-crime investigators, and law enforcement to collect and analyze online evidence.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes secure, anonymous workspaces for capturing and analyzing investigative content and explicitly names the specialist audiences: https://jobs.lever.co/authentic8/adfd9fa8-f386-41a9-bdd3-b62ea4e5012d.

pricing_page.notes: Authentic8 has a public plans-and-pricing page describing per-user annual pricing: https://authentic8.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Authentic8’s customer stories identify Secure Network Technologies and describe MPGSOC using Silo for Research for investigations. Sources: https://www.authentic8.com/why-authentic8/success-stories/silo-helps-white-hat-hackers-secure-clients-networks and https://www.authentic8.com/resources/success-stories. | named_customers.0: Secure Network Technologies is named in Authentic8’s customer success story about white-hat hackers using Silo. | named_customers.1: The customer-story listing explicitly describes MPGSOC using Silo for Research to investigate security issues.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook reports 127 employees, which falls in the 101–200 band: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/52264-81. This is a third-party headcount.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Authentic8’s company profile explicitly lists Redwood City, California as its headquarters: https://linkedin.com/company/571385. | hq_country: The legal-entity record explicitly identifies the headquarters country as the United States: https://www.gleif.org/lei/2549009TD9M2J0O7Q179.

founded_year.notes: The company’s about page explicitly says it was established in 2010: https://authentic8.com/about-us.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index lists investigation guidance, OSINT, managed attribution, and other customer-facing content, rather than two engineering-authored accounts of building the product: https://authentic8.com/blog.

public_docs.notes: The public help center lists multiple product-documentation articles, including browser compatibility, minimum system requirements, and supported operating systems: https://support.authentic8.com/support/home.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The complete readable job board lists Governance Administration Specialist and Sales Development Representative, Commercial; neither is a qualifying AI/ML/data-science role: https://jobs.lever.co/authentic8.

model_provider.notes: No model or model-provider name was found in the product documentation, product/security FAQ, launch blog, or subprocessor list. They refer generically to external AI providers; Brave is identified as a search API provider, not an AI model provider. Sources: https://support.authentic8.com/support/solutions/articles/16000236939-silo-nexus-ai; https://authentic8.com/silo-nexus-ai; https://authentic8.com/blog/whats-new-with-silo-nexus-ai-v2; https://authentic8.com/third-party-processors.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Authentic8 publicly names all five requested compliance standards on its platform-assurance page: https://authentic8.com/certifications. These are reported as company claims, not independently validated certifications. | compliance_certs.0: The platform-assurance page explicitly names SOC 2. | compliance_certs.1: The platform-assurance page explicitly names ISO 27001. | compliance_certs.2: The platform-assurance page explicitly names HIPAA. | compliance_certs.3: The platform-assurance page explicitly names GDPR. | compliance_certs.4: The platform-assurance page explicitly names PCI DSS.

raised_18mo.notes: Vistara’s October 2025 announcement establishes a US$12 million debt financing within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026: https://vistaragrowth.com/portfolio-news/vistara-growth-invests-12m-in-authentic8.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live commercial SDR posting is also listed on the current careers board: https://jobs.lever.co/authentic8/0cdeb8d9-72b8-4eba-ba13-1432e6eb24cc and https://jobs.lever.co/authentic8.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 19, 2026 Nexus AI v2 announcement falls within six months of November 9, 2026 and introduces substantial capabilities, including investigation roles, additional file formats, browser integration, and custom prompts: https://authentic8.com/blog/whats-new-with-silo-nexus-ai-v2.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Miguel Ramos’s profile dates his Chief Product Officer role to January 2026, following Head of Product through January 2026: https://linkedin.com/in/miguelramosv. This counts his promotion into a C-level role as a leadership appointment within the window; it was not a new-company hire.
